# Parity oracle input list — consumed by scripts/capture-kses-fixtures.php, NOT by Go.
# Format: <id>\t<kind>\t<tier>\t<input>  (literal \n \t \\ escapes decoded by the script)
# Keyed 1:1 to internal/sanitize/testdata/parity/fixtures.json. The Go test reads
# fixtures.json only; this file exists so a re-capture reads the same inputs.
#
# --- D1..D15 divergences ---
D1-script-stripped	post_content	B	<script>alert(1)</script>
D2-style-element-stripped	post_content	B	<style>.x{color:red}</style>
D3-javascript-href-dropped	post_content	B	<a href="javascript:alert(1)">x</a>
D4-img-longdesc-not-in-tierB	post_content	B	<img src="a.png" longdesc="javascript:alert(1)">
D5-video-poster-not-in-tierB	post_content	B	<video poster="javascript:alert(1)" src="v.mp4">
D6-object-not-in-tierB	post_content	B	<object data="x"></object>
D7-uppercase-element-lowercased	post_content	B	<A HREF="http://x/" TITLE="t">y</A>
D8-bare-anchor-survives-tierB	post_content	B	<a>text</a>
D8-bare-anchor-survives-tierA	comment_content	A	<a>text</a>
D9-percent-encoding-normalized	post_content	B	<a href="/x?a=%41&b">y</a>
D10-background-image-relative-url-dropped	post_content	B	<p style="background-image: url(/rel.png)">x</p>
D11-aspect-ratio-dropped	post_content	B	<p style="aspect-ratio:16/9">x</p>
D12-mathml-dropped	post_content	B	<math><mi>x</mi></math>
D13-title-textarea-dropped	post_content	B	<title>a</title><textarea>a</textarea>
D14-block-delimiter-dropped-tierA	comment_content	A	<!-- wp:paragraph --><p>Hi</p><!-- /wp:paragraph -->
# D15-non-utf8-bytes-tierB carries raw bytes 61 ff fe 62; fixtures.json keys it as
# encoding=hex since inputs.txt and JSON are both UTF-8 text (bytes shown here as a note).
D15-non-utf8-bytes-tierB	post_content	B	a\xff\xfeb
#
# --- seven design-verified behaviors ---
V-block-delimiters-survive-tierB	post_content	B	<!-- wp:paragraph --><p>Hi</p><!-- /wp:paragraph -->
V-uppercase-element-lowercased-tierB	post_content	B	<EM>Hi</EM>
V-relative-url-kept-tierB	post_content	B	<a href="/local/page">y</a>
V-tel-url-kept-tierB	post_content	B	<a href="tel:+15551234">call</a>
V-class-dropped-tierA	comment_content	A	<em class="x">hi</em>
V-class-kept-tierB	post_content	B	<em class="x">hi</em>
V-srcset-dropped-tierB	post_content	B	<img src="a.png" srcset="a-2x.png 2x">
V-entities-amp-lt-gt-tierB	post_content	B	5 < 6 & 7 > 2
#
# --- title path samples ---
T-em-title-reduced-to-text	post_title	B	<em>Hello</em>
T-amp-title-decoded	post_title	B	5 &amp; 6
T-nested-encoding-title-emptied	post_title	B	&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;
#
# --- one fixture per tier-A element ---

tierA-el-i	comment_content	A	<i>text</i>
tierA-el-q	comment_content	A	<q cite="http://x/">text</q>
tierA-el-s	comment_content	A	<s>text</s>
tierA-el-strike	comment_content	A	<strike>text</strike>
tierA-el-strong	comment_content	A	<strong>text</strong>

# --- tier-B sample weighted toward scheme-bearing / style-bearing attributes ---
